title: Countdown Check-In Consistency
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=countdown:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as checkins, latest(days_remaining) as days_remaining by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks whether a seasonal countdown stays part of the routine or gets forgotten until the last minute.
value: Consistency is what makes a countdown feel playful instead of turning into a forgotten widget.
implementation: Send daily countdown interactions to `index=personal`; chart check-in count and latest days remaining over time.
visualization: Daily chart of countdown check-ins against days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It measures whether you keep checking in with a countdown steadily or forget about it until the very end.
